books.title: Atomic Habits
books.author: James Clear
books.description: A practical guide to building good habits, breaking bad ones, and making small changes that lead to remarkable results.
books.review: A practical and motivating guide to making small improvements that can lead to meaningful changes in everyday life.

books.title: The Psychology of Money
books.author: Morgan Housel
books.description: Explore how people think about money, make financial decisions, and build long-term wealth.
books.review: An accessible exploration of the emotional and behavioral side of money, saving, and investing.

books.title: Rich Dad Poor Dad
books.author: Robert T. Kiyosaki
books.description: Learn foundational ideas about financial education, assets, liabilities, and building wealth.
books.review: Introduces contrasting attitudes toward money and encourages readers to learn more about personal finance.

books.title: Deep Work
books.author: Cal Newport
books.description: Discover strategies for focused, distraction-free work and producing valuable results.
books.review: Offers ideas and practical strategies for reducing distractions and developing focused work habits.

books.title: The Alchemist
books.author: Paulo Coelho
books.description: A young shepherd travels in search of treasure and discovers lessons about dreams and purpose.
books.review: A symbolic adventure about following dreams, noticing opportunities, and discovering meaning along the way.

books.title: Think and Grow Rich
books.author: Napoleon Hill
books.description: A classic personal-development book about goal setting, persistence, and achievement.
books.review: A classic motivational work focused on ambition, persistence, planning, and personal achievement.

books.title: The 7 Habits of Highly Effective People
books.author: Stephen R. Covey
books.description: Learn principles for personal effectiveness, leadership, and meaningful relationships.
books.review: Presents a principle-centered approach to personal development, communication, and leadership.

books.title: Ikigai
books.author: Héctor García and Francesc Miralles
books.description: An introduction to Japanese ideas about purpose, daily routines, and living a fulfilling life.
books.review: Explores ideas about purpose, daily habits, and finding enjoyment in ordinary life.

books.title: The Hobbit
books.author: J. R. R. Tolkien
books.description: Bilbo Baggins joins a group of dwarves on an adventure to reclaim their lost treasure.
books.review: A fantasy adventure filled with memorable characters, imaginative places, and unexpected challenges.

books.title: The Power of Now
books.author: Eckhart Tolle
books.description: Explore mindfulness and the practice of focusing on the present moment.
books.review: Introduces mindfulness concepts and encourages readers to pay attention to the present moment.
